notes: Conventions are internal Core rules. They do not affect current site behavior.

conventions.directories: Use lowercase kebab-case for directory names.
conventions.files: Use lowercase kebab-case for named JSON files and index.json for collection entry points.
conventions.ids: Use stable lowercase kebab-case identifiers. Never reuse an id for a different meaning.
conventions.slugs: Use public URL-compatible lowercase kebab-case slugs without accents.
conventions.versions: Use semantic versions for contracts and schemas. Use explicit year fields for legal annual tables.
conventions.dates: Use ISO 8601 date strings in YYYY-MM-DD format for Core metadata.
conventions.owners: Use an accountable owner string such as Calcule Trabalhador or a future team name.
conventions.status: Use only lifecycle states declared in /data/core/lifecycle/index.json unless a schema explicitly allows another controlled status.
conventions.json: Use valid JSON only, with explicit arrays for list-like fields and no comments.
